name: 4a-webhook-relay
description: Inbound webhook relay — tails the 4A gateway's per-pubkey inbox stream, decrypts hook gift-wraps, and forwards them to Sonata's webhook dispatcher.
author: evan108108

actions.name: 4a_pubkey_get
actions.description: Return the plugin's operational pubkey — the identity the inbox stream is authenticated with and the pubkey to embed in webhook URLs (https://api.4a4.ai/v0/hook/<pubkey>/<slug>).
